# cb:b424 · dag-is-canonical-home-for-behavioral-commitment

> Behavioral invariants belong in DAG contracts, not scattered across the agent-instruction file, struct definitions, or skill prose. Every code module encoding domain rules has a corresponding DAG contract. Agent-instruction files (a skill definition, the agent-instruction file) translate intent and reference the DAG; they do not carry logic of their own.
